fixtures.pair: election result, primary assignment id, identity records, exposure/key digests, possession proofs, publication slots -> evmassign.VerifyPrimary, evmstate, posrelayer, xrepo
custody's exposure ids, exposure digests, key digests and exposure chains (genesis, primary, quantized, recovery) -> evmassign digests
custody storage slots of the getters the root proves -> evmstate layout
custody's state after applying the root's records (ids, digests, states, H rounds, closure anchors, offsets, session outcome) -> xrepo
the root's Closure, RecoveryAck, Ack and SessionClosed records with real ids and digests -> custody.applyRootRecords, verbatim (XRepoRecords.t.sol)

the root's Retirement records with custody's exposure-chain reference digests and a root-signed equivocation of a retiring identity's key -> SealRegistry.importRootRecords -> custody.applyRootRecords verbatim -> Evidence hold -> mature and claim (XRepoRetirement.t.sol)

root-signed equivocations by the old and the new root key of an identity whose rotation custody activates with an Ack -> Evidence.submitEvidence: historical attribution, KeyMismatch for the old key in the new epoch (XRepoRotationEvidence.t.sol)

the B7 relation interface: candidate limits and relation ID, the per-epoch registry commitment C_e over the stored entry words, and the canonical journal codec -> B7Relation.sol (B7RelationVectors.t.sol)
pos-relayer genesis --out-contracts (genesis assignment id of the FULL configuration, identities) -> script/P85Genesis.s.sol (XRepoGenesis.t.sol)

root vote/timeout evidence digests (VI, VH, PV, digest, signatures, seal data) -> RootVoteCbor, Evidence.submitEvidence (EvidenceDigest.t.sol reads the forge-shaped conversion script/evidence-corpus-convert.py writes, regenerated and diffed in CI)
record envelope, ids, payload shapes, closure repeat/conflict cases -> AuthenticatedRecords.t.sol (digest words replaced there)
registry import calls, companions, rootRecordsHash -> RootRecordsImport.t.sol
